biggest_catch: The friend must open BOTH a Share Savings and a Kasasa Checking account - a savings account alone doesn't count - and evergreenDIRECT can cancel the promotion at any time without notice.
catches: $25 to you and $25 to your friend when they become a member with a Share Savings AND a Kasasa Checking account.
No limit to how many referrals you can earn.
Bonus paid within two weeks of account opening.
Friend bonus considered interest, tax-reported over $10; referrer bonus may be tax-reported over $600.
evergreenDIRECT CU reserves the right to cancel the promotion at any time without prior notification.
Separate loan-referral flyer from the same CU pays $50 each side for a $5,000+ funded loan (24+ month term) - not claimed here but worth noting.
